caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar centered on a plain, light background. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly narrower base, a rounded shoulder, and a thick, flared rim. Its surface is predominantly light blue-gray, with deep blue decorative motifs resembling stylized leaves or wings arranged in a horizontal band around the upper body and a single matching motif on the lower part. The top interior of the jar is shaded in brown to indicate depth. The artist's signature, "Chas. F. Wess," and the year "1884" are inscribed in blue near the lower left edge of the image. No other objects or background elements are present in the drawing.
title: Gray Stoneware Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
